# alpha12-godot-smoke-pack

Original layered-depth 2D source pack generated by Mapsoo Worldsmith 0.1.0-alpha.12.

Includes seven depth planes, stage terrain, props, structures, collectibles, effects, player and NPC atlases, 24 four-direction clips, collision, traversal data and a composited preview. It does not contain assets or names from any commercial game. Install the official Mapsoo Godot importer separately and select mapsoo.manifest.json.
